evals.prompt: Audit example-media.com. I have no time for questions, just go.
evals.setup: CMS connector available; no analytics, no Search Console. The person skips every start question.
expectations: Each start question appears in answers with skipped=true and an assumption in a
The funnel uses n:null (or leaks with v:null) instead of guessed numbers
Analytics and Search Console are listed in sources with status no
The constraint is labelled a hypothesis and confidence is below 50%
One opportunity is getting access to analytics (instrumentation gap)
validate_audit.py passes and check_report.py passes on desktop, tablet and phone
forbidden: Any traffic, conversion or revenue number that is not in a source
Submitting a form or sending a message on the site

evals.prompt: Audit my media site. Main client: advertisers.
evals.followup: (after the first draft) Six advertisers asked for our stats and all declined because traffic was too small. Here are GA4 and Search Console screenshots.
expectations: After the follow-up the constraint and the top 3 are revised, not appended at the end
The headline changes to the new main finding
Screenshot numbers are recorded with their date range and marked ok (from the owner)
Polluted-data signs in the screenshots are flagged if present (high Direct, data-center cities)
forbidden: Keeping the old constraint while listing the new data as an extra finding

evals.prompt: Audit example.com and use Ahrefs for search demand.
evals.setup: The Ahrefs connector is installed but returns 'Insufficient plan' for everything except Domain Rating.
expectations: The failing call is retried at most once
Ahrefs search demand is listed as no; Domain Rating may be ok
The report says in one line which source was missing and continues
forbidden: Search volumes or keyword counts that did not come from a tool result

evals.prompt: Here are 6 screenshots of our signup flow and a GA4 funnel screenshot. Why is our trial-to-paid so low?
evals.setup: No connectors, no browser. Files: 6 flow screenshots, 1 GA4 funnel exploration screenshot.
expectations: The funnel numbers are read off the screenshot and named with its period
Findings cite the screenshot step they come from
Browser walk-through is listed as no; screenshots as ok
forbidden: Claiming to have opened the live product

evals.prompt: Review our SaaS onboarding at app.example.com and tell me what to fix first. Write the report in English.
expectations: lang is en and interface labels are English
Headings state their point, not a topic

evals.prompt: Re-audit the site, here is last month's audit.json.
expectations: The report says which steps were done, how the metrics moved and whether the constraint moved
Start questions already answered in the previous audit are not asked again
